content.objective: Nối hai ý đối lập bằng although / even though + mệnh đề, despite / in spite of + danh từ / V-ing, và However, ở đầu câu mới.
explanation: Although, though, even though + mệnh đề (chủ ngữ + động từ): Although it was late, we kept working. Even though mạnh hơn although.

Despite, in spite of + danh từ hoặc V-ing (không phải mệnh đề): Despite the rain, we went out. In spite of being tired, she finished the report. Muốn dùng mệnh đề thì thêm the fact that: despite the fact that it was raining.
However đứng đầu câu mới (hoặc sau dấu chấm phẩy), theo sau là dấu phẩy, để nối với câu trước: The hotel was expensive. However, the rooms were small.
Không dùng despite of, không dùng although với danh từ, và không dùng although cùng but trong một câu.

Whereas và while nối hai vế để đối chiếu hai sự việc khác nhau: My brother loves sport, whereas I prefer reading. Nevertheless và even so nghĩa giống However (tuy vậy), cũng đứng đầu câu mới và theo sau là dấu phẩy: The test was hard. Nevertheless, most students passed.
usage: Viết luận, đoạn văn: The film got good reviews. However, I didn't like it.
Nói điều bất ngờ: She went to work although she had a cold.
Câu gọn với danh từ: We enjoyed the trip in spite of the bad weather.

structures.label: Although
structures.pattern: Although / Even though + mệnh đề, + mệnh đề
structures.example: Although it was late, we kept working.

structures.label: Despite
structures.pattern: Despite / In spite of + danh từ / V-ing, + mệnh đề
structures.example: Despite the rain, we went out.

structures.label: However
structures.example: I studied hard. However, I failed the test.

structures.label: Đối chiếu
structures.pattern: mệnh đề, + whereas / while + mệnh đề
structures.example: My brother loves sport, whereas I prefer reading.

mistakes.wrong: Despite it was raining, they played football.
mistakes.right: Although it was raining, they played football.
mistakes.noteVi: Trước mệnh đề dùng although, không dùng despite.

mistakes.wrong: Although of the cold, she went swimming.
mistakes.right: Despite the cold, she went swimming.
mistakes.noteVi: Trước danh từ dùng despite / in spite of.

mistakes.wrong: Although it was late, but we kept working.
mistakes.right: Although it was late, we kept working.
mistakes.noteVi: Không dùng although và but cùng một câu.

practice.text: ___ it was late, we kept working.
practice.explanationVi: Sau là mệnh đề (it was late): Although.
Sau là danh từ (the rain): Despite.

practice.text: The hotel was expensive. ___, the rooms were small.
practice.explanationVi: Đầu câu mới, có dấu phẩy: However.

practice.promptVi: Điền một từ vào chỗ trống.
practice.text: In spite ___ being tired, she finished the report.
She went to work ___ she had a cold.
practice.explanationVi: Sau là mệnh đề (she had a cold): although.

practice.text: He didn't get the job ___ his experience.
practice.explanationVi: Sau là danh từ (his experience): despite.
